summary: Preview URL returns 'Preview Unavailable' (agent asleep), blocking external frontend + public API testing. Verified backend via localhost:8001 instead. Auth/login, /auth/me and /companies work. GET /api/employees crashes with 500 due to pydantic validation error (company_id required-string but admin has None).
passed: Backend service RUNNING under supervisor, healthy on localhost:8001
Login sets httpOnly cookie and /auth/me works with it

failed.issue: Public preview URL shows 'Preview Unavailable!!! Our Agent is resting after inactivity.' Frontend HTML returns 200 but title is 'Not Found' and /api/* returns 404 (from ingress, not FastAPI). Cannot exercise the app as a user until the preview is woken up from app.emergent.sh.

failed.issue: GET /api/employees returns 500 Internal Server Error. Pydantic ValidationError in EmployeeResponse: 'company_id: Input should be a valid string [input_value=None]'. The seeded super_admin user has company_id=None, so building the response fails. Fields likely need Optional[str] (company_id, branch_id, department_id, designation_id) in models/employee.py EmployeeResponse.
failed.evidence: routes/employees.py:117 EmployeeResponse(...) -> pydantic_core.ValidationError: 'company_id Input should be a valid string [type=string_type, input_value=None]'. Reproduced via `curl -b cookie http://localhost:8001/api/employees` -> 'Internal Server Error' HTTP 500.

failed.issue: GET /api/attendance/today returns 404 with {'detail':'No attendance record for today'} when the user has not checked in yet. This is likely to break the frontend Attendance page unless the client explicitly handles 404. Preferred behaviour: return 200 with {checked_in: false} or null so the UI can render the Check-In button cleanly.
failed.evidence: curl -b cookie http://localhost:8001/api/attendance/today -> HTTP 404 {'detail':'No attendance record for today'}

failed.issue: Could not test any UI flow (login form, dashboard, sidebar navigation, theme toggle, companies/employees/attendance pages) because the preview environment is asleep. Playwright saw 'Preview Unavailable' page on both / and /login; no email/password/submit inputs detected.

action_items: Wake the preview environment (open app.emergent.sh -> restart app) so external URL routes /api to backend and serves the React app; without this no user-facing testing is possible.
Fix EmployeeResponse in /app/backend/models/employee.py: make company_id, branch_id, department_id, designation_id Optional[str] = None. Then GET /api/employees will return 200.
Change /api/attendance/today to return 200 with a 'checked_in: false' payload (or null) instead of 404 when there is no record, so the AttendancePage renders the check-in state cleanly.
After the above, re-run full frontend + integration testing (login -> dashboard -> employees table -> companies grid -> check-in/out -> theme toggle -> responsive sidebar).
